verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents personal access tokens that let scripts, CI jobs and tools use the REST API or Git over HTTPS "with only the permissions you grant" [gitcafe-docs-22], which covers least-privilege credentials for an agent. Its MCP server also gates write actions on issues and pull requests behind user approval [gitcafe-docs-23]. missing for 10: details of scope granularity (per-repo or per-org limits, read vs write), token expiry and revocation controls, agent-specific or non-human identities distinct from acting "as you", and independent or hands-on corroboration.
